title: Nora and Pipkin's Sleepy Glowworm
markdown:
Are you ready for a story? Nora the teddy and Pipkin the dormouse are best friends! Nora is fluffy like a cloud. Pipkin is tiny with the wiggliest whiskers! Wiggle, wiggle!

They lived in a cozy room with a big blanket fort! It was made of stripy, spotty, and sparkly blankets. So fun!

But today… oh no! Their fort was all floppy! Nora’s socks stuck out! A button was gone!

Nora sighed, "Pipkin, our fort looks like a happy mess!"

Pipkin’s whiskers twitched! "It’s so messy, it looks like a rainbow sneezed! ACHOO! Muahahaha!" He giggled like bells.

"We need to tidy it," said Nora. "Before the stars come out."

"Tidy? Oh, what fun!" squeaked Pipkin. "Tidying is an adventure!"

Off they went! Nora tucked in blankets. Pipkin zoomed and nudged bits into place.

They fluffed and smoothed. Nora’s socks made a neat pile. Pipkin rolled yarn. The fort walls stood tall, and the floor was soft. It smelled so nice! Perfect!

Just as they finished, and the first star peeked out – blink! blink! – Nora whispered, "Look, Pipkin! The stars are saying hello!"

Then, they heard it. A tiny… hmmm. It was like a happy bumblebee humming. It came from Nora’s fluffy paw.

"What’s that noise?" Pipkin whispered.

Nora lifted her paw carefully. And guess what? Tucked in a cozy spot was a teeny-tiny creature, glowing with soft light. It was a glowworm! It looked sleepy. Its light pulsed, soft and slow. Pulse… pulse…

"Oh, hello!" whispered Nora. "You’re so glowy! And sleepy!"

The glowworm blinked its light. Blink. Blink. It seemed to say, "Hello. Thank you for being quiet."

"He needs a cozy place to sleep," said Pipkin, full of kindness.

"He does!" agreed Nora. "And look! Our fort is tidy, warm, and safe. It’s perfect for a sleepy glowworm!"

Nora nudged a soft blanket towards the glowworm. Pipkin tiptoed near. The glowworm settled down like a little jewel. Its glow got softer, and its hmmm became a sleepy purr.

Nora snuggled down. Pipkin curled up beside her. The fort was tidy, stars were peeking, and the glowworm was sleeping soundly.

"Goodnight, little glowworm," whispered Nora.

"Sleepy dreams," squeaked Pipkin.

With the glowworm’s gentle light twinkling, and the friendly stars watching, Nora and Pipkin closed their eyes and went to sleep in their wonderfully tidy fort. It was the happiest, coziest, most peaceful bedtime ever.
characters: Nora the nursery teddy, Pipkin the dormouse
